tasks.short: Collect, dissect and examine animal specimens

steps.what: Collect animal specimens using the actual authorized study method and preserve their identity and condition
inputs: actual authorized collection method, site and specimen handling requirements
actual animal specimens and collection circumstances
outputs: collected identified animal specimens and actual collection observations

steps.what: Dissect animal specimens and prepare the actual tissue or specimen for microscope examination
inputs: collected identified animal specimens and actual collection observations
actual dissection method, equipment and specimen handling requirements
outputs: prepared identified specimens and actual dissection observations

steps.what: Examine specimens under microscope, adjust the view and identify observed structures and uncertainty
inputs: prepared identified specimens and actual dissection observations
outputs: biologist's actual microscope findings and uncertainty linked to specimen identity

steps.what: Enter actual collection, dissection and microscope observations, reconcile specimen identity and check the complete examination record and destination in specimen data software (OPS_SYSTEM)
inputs: collected identified animal specimens and actual collection observations
prepared identified specimens and actual dissection observations
biologist's actual microscope findings and uncertainty linked to specimen identity
outputs: exact checked specimen examination record, uncertainty and internal destination

steps.what: Save the exact checked specimen examination record in its intended internal specimen revision
inputs: exact checked specimen examination record, uncertainty and internal destination

tasks.design: Keep collection, dissection and microscope examination with the biologist. Configure {OPS_SYSTEM} to reuse the selected study/specimen identifiers during actual observation entry; the biologist supplies and checks every finding before saving the final record.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated specimen context entry can interrupt a documented examination; interpreting actual anatomy remains specialist work.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing specimen-record software may support fixed study and specimen context within an examination session.
tasks.still_hard: Collection integrity, physical preparation, microscopy and deciding what a structure means remain human work.
tasks.human_edge: The biologist recognizes preparation artefacts and uncertainty in the actual specimen.

ambition.what: Reduce repeated identifiers within an actual documented examination.

build_days.consent_and_access: 1-2 with the study owner and specimen data administrator

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: specimen data systems can retain selected specimen context, while collecting, dissecting and examining animal specimens requires actual physical and observational work.

assumptions: This is an actual specimen examination episode with an existing examination record; no new report, image acquisition or duplicated note is added.
The biologist produces all collection, dissection and microscopy observations in s1-s3 and captures and reconciles them in s4. No structured findings, image feed or diagnosis is assumed to exist.
Reuse only existing selected specimen/study identifiers. Missing, conflicting or changed identity requires manual reconciliation; no observation or species identification is inferred.
Check native context retention first. If it already exists, there is no additional saving. Existing microscope functionality and save runtime earn no saving.

Shares 20/30/30/19/1 are provisional unmeasured active-effort allocations for this episode, independent of the prompt prior. Gross saving is 19 times 0.10 = 1.9 hours per 100 baseline hours; 0.75 upkeep leaves 1.15 net. The one-unit save is fully retained as a near-zero placeholder and produces no saving.

Final record checking in s4 is ordinary authoring work. Any record or destination edit invalidates the gate and requires another complete check. Collection and dissection are manual physical task work, with actual existing study authority and handling requirements, not software execution.
unknowns: Whether native specimen context retention is already configured
Actual share of repeated context entry in documented examinations
research_questions: Observe examinations to measure repeated identifiers versus actual findings entry and microscopy.
Check specimen software context reuse and identity error handling with the study owner.

already_counted.description: All physical specimen work, actual observation capture and final record checking remain counted.

incremental.description: Maintain specimen context defaults and check occasional identity mismatches.

approvals.approved_version: exact checked specimen examination record, uncertainty and internal destination

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Unmeasured E1 opportunity, conditional on repeated identifier entry actually occurring; below the provisional 1.15 percent net ceiling.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

reach: Study owner and specimen data administrator for native context reuse
role.ambitious_version: More consistent specimen records while preserving actual collection, dissection and microscope expertise.
